WS::request
Description
WS::request protocol
Returns the value of Sec-WebSocket-Protocol header field in client
request.
WS::request extension
Returns the value of Sec-WebSocket-Extensions header field in client
request.
WS::request version
Returns the value of Sec-WebSocket-Version header field in client
request.
WS::request key
Returns the value of Sec-WebSocket-Key header field in client request.
Syntax
WS::request ('protocol' | 'extension' | 'version' | 'key' )
Return Value
This command can be used to lookup the values of various Websocket
header fields seen in a client request.
Valid During
WS_REQUEST
Examples
when
WS_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
WS
::
request
protocol
]
equals
"chat"
}
{
WS
::
enabled
false
}
}
Change Log
